test_title: PYST 16: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: P is the sister of Q. Q is the mother of S. S is the brother of R. R is the father of T. T is the husband of U. How is R related to U?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) P is the sister of Q.

2) Q is the mother of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/094359fde5dfd1d02b7e859f856a936450dedc8b7893f51594fc10307395bee7.png] 

3) S is the brother of R.

4) R is the father of T.

5) T is the husband of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/293325327304a8ec080b949a79356b8927f034be3bd1160bc59bb7bd3c37feb9.png] 

Thus, R is the **husband's father** of U.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
